question: Who won the first season of Ranji trophy in 1934-35?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Ranji Trophy** is a domestic first-class cricket championship played in India, named after the famous Indian cricketer **Kumar Shri Ranjitsinhji**.

• The inaugural season of the Ranji Trophy was held in the year **1934-35**, and the final match took place between **Bombay** and **Northern India**.

• **Bombay** won the first-ever Ranji Trophy championship by defeating Northern India in the final. The final was played at the **Bombay Gymkhana Ground**.

• Bombay (now Mumbai) is historically one of the strongest teams in Indian domestic cricket, having won the **Ranji Trophy a record number of times**.

• The championship is played in a **knockout format**, and later evolved to include a league stage to identify the top teams for the finals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Ranji Trophy Format:** 

• The competition initially followed a knockout format but later adopted a combination of league and knockout stages to ensure fair play and enhance competitiveness.

• Teams represent different states, regions, and cricket associations in India.

• The tournament is governed by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.

• **Significance of Bombay's Victory:** 

• Bombay's victory in the inaugural season marked the beginning of its dominance in Indian domestic cricket.

• Bombay went on to become one of the most successful teams in the history of the Ranji Trophy, with over **40 titles** to its name.

• **Notable Players:** 

• Several legendary cricketers have represented Bombay in the Ranji Trophy, including **Sunil Gavaskar**, **Dilip Vengsarkar**, **Sachin Tendulkar**, and **Ajinkya Rahane**.

• The Ranji Trophy has been a platform for nurturing young talent and preparing players for international cricket.

• **Historical Context:** 

• The Ranji Trophy was introduced to promote cricket in India and provide domestic players with competitive match experience.

• The tournament has contributed significantly to the development of Indian cricket and the identification of future stars.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Other Notable Teams:** 

• **Madras** (now Tamil Nadu), **Holkar**, and **Delhi** have also been prominent teams in the history of the Ranji Trophy.

• Holkar, a dominant team in the early years, produced cricket legends like **C.K. Nayudu**.

• **Modern Era of Ranji Trophy:** 

• Over time, the format has evolved to include a group stage followed by knockouts, allowing more teams to participate.

• The Ranji Trophy continues to be a critical tournament for Indian cricket, serving as a stepping stone for players aspiring to represent the national team.

• **Records and Achievements:** 

• Bombay holds the record for the most consecutive Ranji Trophy titles, winning **15 straight championships** from 1958-59 to 1972-73.

• Players like **Wasim Jaffer** and **Amol Muzumdar** hold individual records for runs and centuries in the tournament.
